note: Components are the shared vocabulary for adapters. This repo does not ship a per-episode Canvas page or a physics engine.

components.purpose: One number hits the frame, then shrinks into a chart. One number per beat.
Two-bar comparison. The spoken line carries only one of the two numbers.
A single stamp for one rule or one wasted stop.
A character plays an action on the beat. Idle beside a chart fails QC.
Tips are on-screen cards. The voice does not read first, second, third.

implementations.note: Draws review stills from <episode>/render/stills.json with headless Chrome. No video, no timeline, no audio. Characters are stand-ins until ip/ sprites are vendored.
